function.name: open_app
function.description: Open a desktop application installed on this computer.

function.name: open_site
function.description: Open a website in the browser. Give the domain or full URL, e.g. youtube.com — a bare word is treated as a search.

function.name: play_youtube
function.description: Play music or a video on YouTube — a genre, an artist, a song, or just music in general. Use it whenever the thing requested is music or video, and never for a request to open a program or a website.

function.name: open_work_apps
function.description: Open every application the user saved as a work app.

function.name: list_installed_apps
function.description: List the applications installed on this computer.

function.name: list_running_processes
function.description: List the programs currently running on this computer.

function.name: set_reminder
function.description: Set a timer or reminder for later.

function.name: cancel_reminder
function.description: Cancel a reminder by its id.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the internet for current information: news, prices, weather, recent events — anything that changes over time.

function.name: save_preference
function.description: Remember a durable fact the user states about themselves, the tools they use, or how they want things done.

category.description: One of: music_artist, music_genre, work_app, note.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file at an exact path.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or overwrite a file on disk.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List the files and folders in a directory.

function.name: find_and_open_file
function.description: Find a document stored on THIS computer by description and open it, for when the user names their own file without a path. Never use it to look something up on the internet.
